correctness.rationale: Reconstructed non-spoke subcomplex as join of n local matching complexes consisting of an interval and isolated vertex, giving H_(n-1)=Z with blade-permutation sign. For each of 2n spokes its link replaces one local factor by two isolated vertices and includes into the original by H_0-isomorphism. Relative cone decomposition and exact integral pair sequence yield H_n=sgn_blade⊗ker(augmentation Z[W_n]->Z); the group permutes oriented link summands naturally and gives chi(g)=sgn(pi)(2f0(g)-1), N_n invariants n-1 and full group 1 for n=2 else zero. This is exactly the m=5,k=1 specialization of previously published full wreath-product proof; mathematical correctness is supported by both structural derivations. Rank 2n-1 agrees with the 2023 nonequivariant theorem.
